cases.question: ¿Qué asientos registrados no cuadraron entre debe y haber en marzo de 2026? Indica el código, la fecha, el total al debe y el total al haber de cada asiento.
cases.expected_sql: SELECT je.code, je.entry_date, SUM(jed.debit) AS total_debe, SUM(jed.credit) AS total_haber FROM journal_entry je JOIN journal_entry_detail jed ON jed.entry_id = je.id WHERE je.status = TRUE AND je.entry_date >= DATE '2026-03-01' AND je.entry_date < DATE '2026-04-01' GROUP BY je.id, je.code, je.entry_date HAVING ABS(SUM(jed.debit) - SUM(jed.credit)) > 0.01 ORDER BY je.entry_date DESC LIMIT 50
cases.generated_sql: SELECT je.code AS codigo, je.entry_date AS fecha, COALESCE(SUM(jed.debit), 0) AS total_debe, COALESCE(SUM(jed.credit), 0) AS total_haber FROM public.journal_entry AS je JOIN public.journal_entry_detail AS jed ON jed.entry_id = je.id WHERE (je.entry_date >= CAST('2026-03-01' AS DATE) AND je.entry_date < CAST('2026-04-01' AS DATE)) AND je.status = TRUE GROUP BY je.id, je.code, je.entry_date HAVING ABS(COALESCE(SUM(jed.debit), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(jed.credit), 0)) > 0.01 LIMIT 50
